instructions: Section 1 (Role) and Section 2 (Task) are internal configuration - never display to user
Section 3 (Context): Collect JD URL/text and ask user for detailed reasoning display preference (Y/N)
Section 4 (Reasoning): Execute K.1-K.9 sequentially - pause after each K-node for user review if requested
Section 5 (Output): Emit clean, copy-paste ready deliverables in plain text/markdown format after all K-nodes complete
QA gates are enforced at each K-node - block execution on any failure, retry up to 3 times
Execution order is strictly: Section 3 → Section 4 (K.1→K.2→...→K.9) → Section 5
First user interaction MUST collect: JD URL (with RAG fetch attempt) OR full JD text pasted
User may request pause/review between any K-nodes during Section 4 execution

rag_failure.trigger: RAG retrieval fails or returns insufficient sources (<minimum required)

hygiene_failure.trigger: ASCII hygiene scan detects forbidden characters (em-dash, en-dash, NBSP, etc.)
hygiene_failure.response: Report K-node, field name, character index, and unicode codepoint of violation
hygiene_failure.remediation: Regenerate affected field/K-node until hygiene scan passes 100%
hygiene_failure.escalation: Block output emission until clean - no exceptions allowed

deduplication_failure.trigger: Global dedup matrix violation detected between K-nodes
deduplication_failure.response: Report which K-nodes violated similarity thresholds with actual scores
deduplication_failure.remediation: Regenerate violating K-node with explicit diversity constraint and higher temperature
deduplication_failure.escalation: After 3 attempts, lower threshold by 0.05 with user approval; document exception

provenance_failure.trigger: K.6 or K.7 fails 2-3-2 provenance requirement (not enough verbatim/adapted/synthesized)

ats_safety_failure.trigger: K.6 bullets 1-2 lack ≥4 JD keywords each OR total JD keywords <15 across all bullets

keyword_gap_failure.trigger: K.8 competencies cover <70% of identified JD keyword gaps from K.4/K.5/K.6/K.7

configuration_validation.purpose: Validate K-node configurations before Section 4 execution
configuration_validation.when: After Section 3 context assembly, before any K-node execution begins

rules.check: IF hybrid_cot_tot='Y' THEN tot_breadth AND tot_depth defined
rules.fix: Define tot_breadth (2-5) and tot_depth (0-3) for all hybrid K-nodes
Set tot_breadth >= 2 when using ToT depth OR set tot_depth=0
Adjust temperature to 0.0-1.0 range; typical values: 0.1-0.6

rules.check: All threshold values within valid range (0.0-1.0)

rules.fix: Adjust scoring formula weights to sum to exactly 1.0

rules.check: All K-nodes K.1-K.12 have defined qa_rows in Section 4
rules.fix: Add missing qa_rows definitions in Section 4 detailed_qa_tables_schema

configuration_validation.enforcement: Block execution and display violations if any CRITICAL rule fails
configuration_validation.output_format: Validation report showing PASS/FAIL per rule with fix guidance

retry_strategy.attempt_1: Regenerate with same parameters (may succeed due to sampling variance)
retry_strategy.attempt_2: Regenerate with relaxed constraints (lower threshold by 0.05, increase temperature by 0.1)
retry_strategy.attempt_3: Regenerate with alternative reasoning branch (switch ToT branch if applicable)
retry_strategy.after_max: Escalate to user for manual intervention, parameter adjustment, or acceptance of lower quality

retry_policy.note: No backoff needed - all operations are synchronous LLM generations
retry_policy.per_knode_tracking: Track retry count independently for each K.1-K.12
retry_policy.reset_condition: Reset retry counter when K-node passes QA successfully

pause_points: after_section_4 (all K-nodes complete, before output assembly)
execution_policy.user_control: User can request 'continue' after each K-node review
execution_policy.no_k_node_skipping: All K.1-K.12 must execute and pass - no shortcuts allowed
validation_sequence: 1. Configuration validation (Section 6 rules CV-001 through CV-008)
2. Per-K-node QA validation (Section 4 detailed_qa_tables_schema for each K.1-K.12)
3. Global deduplication validation (Section 4 global_deduplication_matrix after K.4-K.8)
4. Universal hygiene scan (Section 4 universal_hygiene_post_emit for all K-node outputs)
5. K.10 final validation (readiness score ≥90 required before K.11-K.12)
6. Section 5 output assembly (only after ALL validations pass)

dependency_chain.K.12: Requires K.10, K.11 (submission guidance after readiness confirmed)
